#!/bin/bash
# Flux job script translated from Slurm

#flux: --job-name=udacity_new_xml_test_train

# The Slurm script requested 4 cores for a single task.
# This is translated to 1 task with 4 CPUs.
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 4

# The original script allowed for multiple partitions ('mhigh,mlow').
# Flux typically accepts a single queue per job. The higher priority queue is chosen here.
#flux: -q mhigh

# Output file with translated placeholders. Slurm's %u (user) has no equivalent.
# Stderr will be merged with stdout by default.
#flux: -o ./out/{job.name}_{job.id}.out

# CRITICAL: The following resource requests from Slurm could not be translated and have been OMITTED.
# These are highly site-specific. This job will likely FAIL without them.
# The job will NOT be allocated a GPU and will NOT be allocated 30GB of memory.
# #SBATCH --gres gpu:1
# #SBATCH --mem 30G

nvidia-smi
export CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1

LEARNING_RATE=1e-3
BATCH_SIZE=1
DECAY_STEP=5

# The python command is run directly, as this is a single-task job.
# The allocated resources (4 CPUs) are available to this process.
python3 test_net.py --dataset pascal_voc --net res101 \
                       --cuda --mGPUs --checksession 1 --checkepoch 20 --checkpoint 2504

issues: CRITICAL: As noted in the script's comments, two essential resource requests from the original Slurm script were omitted: the request for a GPU (`--gres gpu:1`) and the request for 30GB of memory (`--mem 30G`). While the translated script is syntactically valid, it is functionally incorrect. It will not be allocated a GPU and will receive a default, likely insufficient, memory allocation. Both omissions will almost certainly cause the job to fail at runtime.

The script specifies an output file path of `./out/...`. This requires a directory named 'out' to exist in the submission directory. If it does not, the job may fail to start. Adding a `mkdir -p ./out` command to the script would make it more robust.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH -n 4 # Number of cores
#SBATCH --mem 30G # 20GB solicitados.
#SBATCH -p mhigh,mlow # or mlow Partition to submit to
#SBATCH --gres gpu:1 # Para pedir Pascales MAX 8
#SBATCH -o ./out/%x_%u_%j.out # File to which STDOUT will be written
#SBATCH -e ./out/%x_%u_%j.err # File to which STDERR will be written

#SBATCH --job-name=udacity_new_xml_test_train

nvidia-smi
export CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1

LEARNING_RATE=1e-3
BATCH_SIZE=1
DECAY_STEP=5

python3 test_net.py --dataset pascal_voc --net res101 \
                       --cuda --mGPUs --checksession 1 --checkepoch 20 --checkpoint 2504
